scope: Manufacturer buffer-model fidelity/configuration. Does not include PCB extraction or claim DDR functional compliance.

ti.transformation: Original pre-model header and exact selected model blocks, CRLF normalized to LF; waveform and I/V numeric text unchanged; final [End] appended. Original coupled package reference retained, package matrix definition excluded from subset and package modeling explicitly omitted.

clockProfiles.note: At maximum3.3ns clock period specified by TI; a nominal frequency at the bound has no positive cycle-jitter margin.

Current converter handles Winbond read driver but refuses all tested TI write models because complete finite vendor waveforms overlap adjacent transitions. This is converter capability evidence, not a PCB pass/fail verdict.

fixtureProof.tolerance: RMS <=1%VDD and peak <=5%VDD, inherited from converter vendor consistency proof
fixtureProof.limitation: Native ngspice reproduction of vendor V/T fixtures using the same fixtures that produced KU/KD. Tests table conversion consistency; it is not independent accuracy validation and contains no PCB or package.

terminationProof.limitation: DC derivative of converted vendor input clamp/termination tables across VREF +/-100mV; not an independent vendor characterization and not a PCB simulation.

packageChecks.error: IbisError: Coupled vendor package models are unsupported; choose omit explicitly to exclude them
IbisError: A1: nonzero vendor reference/supply-pin package impedance is unsupported; choose packagePolicy=omit explicitly

writeTiming.source: Winbond W631GG6MB RevA02 sections10.6 and10.16.5: Tables18/19/54/55/57, pp102-104 and157-158
writeTiming.baseReference: DQ1V/ns, differentialDQS2V/ns; setup measured at AC150, hold at DC100.
writeTiming.screenMeaning: 85/95ps = base10/45ps + maximum listed supported-cell derating75/50ps. An engineering screen, not a complete characterized mask: still must verify each actual DQ/DQS slew pair is supported, tangent-line conditions and tVAC.
writeTiming.vref: Actual receiver VREFDQ H1; constant ideal half supply assumed. VREF DC and AC deviations not simulated.

readTiming.dcThresholds: DDR_VREF +/-100mV at nominal1.5V. CPU DDR_VREF isJ4. Model498/1002 receiver thresholds correlate with selected corner.
readTiming.acMask: TI provides DDR3 rule-based PCB routing/timing specification rather than a complete public receiver AC setup/hold mask. Do not reuse DRAM write setup/hold as CPU read limits.
readTiming.phase: Winbond read DQS launches edge-aligned with read DQ. Any halfUI capture offset is an explicit PHY delay assumption, not proof of training.

modelSettingAssumptions.tiDrive: Slow9mA SR01 I100, 0.88*Rext, nominalRext50ohm. Fast9mA SR00 I100. Correct PHY register profile and actual VTP reference must match.
modelSettingAssumptions.winbondWrite: ODT60 nominalRZQ/4 with240ohmRZQ; MR1/MR2 and ODT control must select the actual burst termination.
modelSettingAssumptions.winbondRead: DATA40 representsRZQ/6 output setting; DATA34 representsRZQ/7. Match actualMR1 setting.

omissions: Vendor package parasitics excluded: coupled TI package and nonzero reference/supply package impedance unsupported by this converter.
Static IBIS ODT/drive selections assume matching actual PHY, MR1/MR2 and ODT control during a burst.
Minimum/maximum IBIS tables are vendor correlated corners; all corner combinations and VREF noise are not covered.
Write DQS is launched half a UI after DQ; read DQS is edge aligned and needs an explicit receiver sampling shift.
TI publishes rule-based DDR3 PCB timing limits; its public datasheet does not provide a complete read receiver AC setup/hold mask.
